correct_query: SELECT v_name, COUNT(sh_id) AS late_cnt FROM vendor CROSS JOIN package_item AS i1 CROSS JOIN shipment WHERE v_id = i1.vendor_id AND sh_id = i1.pi_sh_id AND status = 'CLOSED' AND i1.received_date > i1.expected_date AND EXISTS (SELECT * FROM package_item AS i2 WHERE i2.pi_sh_id = i1.pi_sh_id AND i2.vendor_id <> i1.vendor_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM package_item AS i3 WHERE i3.pi_sh_id = i1.pi_sh_id AND i3.vendor_id <> i1.vendor_id AND i3.received_date > i3.expected_date) GROUP BY v_name ORDER BY late_cnt DESC, v_name
